InterWeave provides a simple, efficient and scalable system that allows sharing across multiple levels of distributed memory.

the development of a transparent and efficient system for distributed shared memory, and with applications for which distributed sharing is useful.
the design and implementation of a system that provides transparent support for sharing data across multiple levels of distributed systems.
developing a transparent system that allows application programmers to focus on their application rather than on the underlying hardware and communication mechanisms.

InterWeave has demonstrated that sharing can be made to work well across the full spectrum of sharing levels, and that the performance penalty for sharing at the highest levels (i.e. across the Internet) is minimal.

a transparent, language-neutral, and application-transparent memory-sharing system is possible and can support a variety of sharing requirements.
